Author: Tacodile
Name: Soundstage
Punchline: One-click GPose scenes: lights, set, camera and look.
Description: A GPose studio. Pick a Scene and it sets the lights, a backdrop, props, camera, ReShade look and pose in one click, with live sliders and your own saved Scenes. Needs Stagehand for lights and Brio for poses. Open it with /soundstage.
